question: Three measuring tapes are 64 cm. 72 cm and 96 cm, respectively. What is the least length that can be measured by any of the tapes exactly (in cm)?
solution:

Lengths of measuring tapes: 64 cm, 72 cm, 96 cm

To find the least length that can be measured by any of the tapes exactly, we need to find the Least Common Multiple (LCM) of the given lengths.
